programmes.d: Nick struggles to prove himself when he is promoted to co-host alongside the lazy, arrogant Brick Street.
Suzanne serves on a committee at Kevin's school, but her fellow female members disrespect her-but adore Nick.
Nick goes to watch a game with friends at a sports bar.
Suzanne enlists in a salsa-dancing class with Nick, but her controlling nature soon becomes an issue.
Lindsey orders a Michelle Obama sweater online.
As Lindsey films a reality show about her family, Kevin comes across a gun in Suzanne's handbag.
Comical chaos ensues when the gang waits in line to shop at a department store on Black Friday.
Nick tries to become a more effective parent, so he pushes Kevin and Lindsey to become better people.
Nick attends his high-school reunion but must face an embarrassing incident from his past.
Nick worries about his mortality and creates a bucket list featuring overly dangerous activities.
Suzanne becomes the subject to Nick's joke-off, and Suzanne retaliates against him.
Kevin is a soccer fan, Nick does not understand the appeal.
The family oversleeps on the day Lindsey is scheduled to sing the national anthem at a baseball game.
Lindsey and Kevin give to a charity, but Nick must step in when the charity keeps asking for more money.
Suzanne's overprotective mother arrives and causes tension between her and Nick.
Nick attempts to make a profit off an expensive set of African masks that Kevin bought at a yard sale.
Nick tries to give his family the best vacation ever but things do not go well at all.
Suzanne infiltrates Nick's night with the boys, so he retaliates by crashing her all-lady spa getaway.
Nick decides the children need to bond with his mother.
Friends and extended family gather for a Thanksgiving dinner, but Suzanne forgets the turkey.
Former child star Todd Bridges guides Lindsey on a wild odyssey to teach her the dangers of drug use.
Marilyn dates a younger man, but Nick has suspicions about her new beau's true motives.
When the Kingston-Persons decide to have a game night, all bets are off.
Nick secretly plans a surprise for Suzanne to help her overcome a traumatic childhood experience.
Nick and Suzanne look into sending the kids to a private school, only to be misled about the process.
Suzanne gets arrested and decides to change her stubborn ways.
Marilyn decides Lindsey needs to learn how to cook.
Nick learns Suzanne's wedding ring isn't real and sets out to get a real ring before she learns the truth.
Kevin's burgeoning career as a child actor has a negative fallout when a potential big break goes to his head.
Frank is an uninvited guest on Nick's Father's Day trip, but the two bond during an elevator stoppage.
When Suzanne catches Nick spying a rap video with a pole dancer, she shows him her own pole-dancing prowess.
Kevin tries to run for seventh-grade class president, but he is torn about how to run his campaign.
Suzanne has some credit issues she has not revealed to Nick.
Nick is enlisted to host a charity walkathon. Meanwhile, Marilyn's bracelet goes missing.
Suzanne's ex-husband wants to lower his monthly child support payments.
A new morning show is launched at the station, but Nick must cohost it with a self-serving reality star.
Nick flops in his efforts to help Kevin with Valentine's Day at school.
Nick and Suzanne plan to attend a high-profile movie premiere, but their busy schedules create complications.
When Nick misleads Suzanne about spending a gift card, they appear before a TV judge to sort out the truth.
A trip to Walt Disney World is jepardized by a cell-phone snafu and a scheduling conflict.
Nick goes crazy buying items in bulk that the family doesn't need a a discount super store.
Lindsey decides to take on a vegan diet and lifestyle, but she may have ulterior motives in doing so.
Suzanne suspects that Nick may have fathered his ex-flame's son. Ice Cube and Kandi Burruss guest star.
When Nick makes a point that Suzanne is too controlling of the family, Suzanne backs off the issue.
Nick host a fund-raiser for charity. Elsewhere, Suzanne tangles with a wealthy client.
When Marilyn brings a dangerous flu back from a trip to Mexico, the family must quarantine.
Nick retaliates after he overhears Suzanne telling personal information to Gigi.
When Nick lands on a porn website due to a spelling error, a co-worker takes it the wrong way.
Nick angers Suzanne when he invites Martin to an exclusive sporting event before inviting his wife.
Nick serves as a guest speaker for Kevin's class, but his message ultimately confuses Kevin's classmates.
Suzanne reaches out to a relationship expert, then comes to believe she and Nick have compatibility issues.
Suzanne and Marilyn convene for a spa weekend for Mother's Day, but friction soon mounts between the two.
Nick and Suzanne get into an argument and refuse to talk to each other.
Against Nick's wishes, Suzanne buys an expensive purse and Nick becomes suspicious about it.
Lindsey's romantic attentions turn to a young celebrity DJ, who only neglects her in return.
Suzanne insists that everyone in the family tell the truth at all times after she catches Nick in a lie.
The spread of certain secrets could ruin two newfound romances.
Suzanne grows jealous of Nick's pretty young field producer.
Nick and Suzanne go head to head in the kitchen when Nick says cooking is "easy."
Kevin gets roped into taking a test for a peer, spinning into motion various complications.
